verdict.rationale: Manufact Cloud hosts MCP servers at managed URLs (e.g. `https://<slug>--br-<branch>.run.mcp-use.com/mcp`) and offers one-click or copy-paste client configuration, so you never run infrastructure yourself. Requests flow through a hosted gateway or proxy, and existing external servers can be connected by URL with no deploy. Manufact also runs its own official hosted MCP server that any MCP client can connect to. Missing for 10: you still have to push or deploy server code (or a template) before getting a URL; how the gateway routes to downstream tools is thinly documented; no independent hands-on corroboration of connecting a client to a hosted URL.
